<thought>The carbon NMR shows peaks at 144.78, 132.00, 130.07 (two), and 127.80 (two) ppm, all within the aromatic region (≈110‑160 ppm). That totals 1 + 1 + 2 + 2 = 6 aromatic carbon signals. No other peaks fall in this region. Therefore the molecule contains six aromatic carbon atoms.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
